mintAuthority.summary: Machine.deposit transfers USDC, but MachineUtils.manageFees separately mints fee shares without new AUM. The restricted setFeeManager chooses their distributor, and Risk Manager Timelock setters accept unconstrained uint256 maxFixedFeeAccrualRate/maxPerfFeeAccrualRate. The shareLimit is not applied to fee minting. The deposit-cap raise alone is collateral-only, but replaceable fee calculation/distribution plus raiseable fee maxima make wrapper-local dilution economically unbounded; no bytecode upgrade is needed. Parent usdc-circle issuance remains inherited through the dependency.

controls.label: Makina Risk Manager Timelock (mutable fee-accrual maxima)
controls.capDescription: setMaxFixedFeeAccrualRate/setMaxPerfFeeAccrualRate accept uint256 with no immutable ceiling; this is a fee-dilution cap, not only a deposit limit.
controls.evidence: Pinned Machine.riskManagerTimelock() returns this address at block 26113624, hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2; getMinDelay() on this TimelockController returns 172800 seconds at the same pin. Verified Machine source gates both fee-maxima setters with onlyRiskManagerTimelock. Machine.deposit transfers USDC, but MachineUtils.manageFees separately mints fee shares without new AUM. The restricted setFeeManager chooses their distributor, and Risk Manager Timelock setters accept unconstrained uint256 maxFixedFeeAccrualRate/maxPerfFeeAccrualRate. The shareLimit is not applied to fee minting. The deposit-cap raise alone is collateral-only, but replaceable fee calculation/distribution plus raiseable fee maxima make wrapper-local dilution economically unbounded; no bytecode upgrade is needed.

controls.label: Dialectic USD Machine (share issuer)
controls.capDescription: The Machine mints deposit shares against USDC at the current share price up to the Risk-Manager-set share supply cap of 75,000,000 shares. It also mints fee shares without new AUM, diluting holders within the governance-set fee-accrual limits. It does not mint the underlying USDC.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095805 the Machine returns shareToken() = 0x1e33e98af620f1d563fcd3cfd3c75ace841204ef, accountingToken() = 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 (USDC), shareLimit() = 75,000,000e18, riskManager() = 0x36ba7c92cd68051fb304bd4580c4a51c1d376532, and recoveryMode() = false. The share token's minter() and owner() both resolve to this Machine. Makina's fee documentation separately identifies fee-share issuance without new AUM; Machine-only mint authority does not mean every minted share is matched by a fresh USDC deposit.

controls.label: Watermark Fee Manager (fee-share dilution)
controls.capDescription: Fees are charged by minting new shares to fee recipients rather than skimming the accounting token, so they dilute existing holders. Accrual is bounded by the Machine's maxFixedFeeAccrualRate and maxPerfFeeAccrualRate.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25637903 the fee manager returns mgmtFeeRatePerSecond() = 0, smFeeRatePerSecond() = 31709792 (about 0.1% annualized to the Security Module), perfFeeRate() = 1e17 (10% over a high-water mark), and sharePriceWatermark() = 1.034978 USDC. The Machine caps accrual at maxFixedFeeAccrualRate() = 951293760 and maxPerfFeeAccrualRate() = 14269406394 per second, these observed rates restrict the current fee manager but are mutable without immutable maxima and do not establish bounded-by-construction issuance.

controls.label: Makina Risk Manager - 3-of-5 Safe (share supply cap)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25637903 the Machine's riskManager() returns this address; getOwners() returned the five listed EOAs, getThreshold() returned 3, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, getModulesPaginated() returned an empty list, the Safe guard slot is zero, fallbackHandler() returned 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, and the singleton slot returned 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a. Makina documents the share supply cap and the deposit/redemption whitelists as immediate Risk Manager settings, while risk-sensitive parameters route through the separate Risk Manager Timelock 0x38542447c49d24e617fc06113295d7aaa3bec4b6. Raising the cap admits more deposits; it does not let the Risk Manager mint shares without matching USDC.

controls.label: Makina DAO - 3-of-5 Safe (ADMIN_ROLE 0)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25637903 this Safe reads VERSION() 1.4.1, getThreshold() 3 of 5 listed owners, no enabled modules, a zero guard, fallback handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, and singleton 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a. The AccessManager 0x0fcefa3f1047f35521a49cd8b06fabd588665d7f owns every beacon, including the Machine beacon 0x5c680ec39bafe8524f3c2fa9d5f6d65f09bd7333 whose implementation() read 0xb655ad796634562136b593397b8b4849f332213f. Current chain state contradicts Makina's INFRA_UPGRADE_ROLE description: getTargetFunctionRole(Machine beacon, upgradeTo(address)) returned ADMIN_ROLE 0, the DAO has that role with a 172,800-second execution delay, getRoleGuardian(0) returned role 0, and the Security Council holds role 7 rather than role 0. The DAO/original proposer can cancel its scheduled operation, but the Council is not established as cancellation authority for this active selector. D14 pin 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2): AccessManager.getTargetFunctionRole(Machine,setFeeManager(address)) returns role 3; hasRole(3,this Safe) returns active=true with executionDelay=86400. Fresh Ethereum pin 26113908 on 2026-10-03 (hash 0x29e4732a50876c7bac0cd2747133bcb0763791142bf492a9f539b0bc646890e1) confirms getTargetFunctionRole(0x6b006870c83b1cd49e766ac9209f8d68763df721,setFeeManager(address))=3, hasRole(3,this Safe)=(true,86400), and hasRole(0,this Safe)=(true,172800). Thus this Safe can select the local fee-share calculator/distributor after 86,400 seconds as well as upgrade code after 172,800 seconds; timelockDelaySec records the minimum enforced issuance-path delay of 86400, not the beacon-only delay.

controls.label: Makina Security Council - 2-of-4 Safe (guardian, recovery mode, slashing)
bypassSurfaces: RecoveryModeTriggerModule 0xeec7919bab68876e14737970fe4965ab9737cd29 lets executor 0xaa1e36165b3ac105f25549c06e1f06d573a40be3 bypass the Safe's 2-of-4 threshold with zero delay only to request setRecoveryMode(true); it cannot disable Recovery Mode, rotate itself, mint DUSD, raise the share cap, or upgrade code.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25637903 the Machine's securityCouncil() returns this address; getOwners() returned four listed EOAs, getThreshold() returned 2, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, getModulesPaginated() returned enabled module 0xeec7919bab68876e14737970fe4965ab9737cd29, the guard slot was zero, fallbackHandler() returned 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, and the singleton slot returned 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a. The module is verified as RecoveryModeTriggerModule: its immutable SAFE is this Security Council and its only operational path lets the unattributed EOA executor 0xaa1e36165b3ac105f25549c06e1f06d573a40be3 ask the Safe to call setRecoveryMode(true) on a Machine endpoint; only the Safe can replace that executor. The broad Safe path remains 2-of-4, while this narrow module path is effectively 1-of-1 and zero-delay. At block 25638710 the DUSD AsyncRedeemer reported isWhitelistEnabled() = true, finalizationDelay() = 43,200 seconds, nextRequestId() = 343, and lastFinalizedRequestId() = 342. Makina classifies the Security Council as fully trusted: it cannot mint shares, but it can trigger Recovery Mode, force an AUM update past the share-price rate limit (which changes the price at which shares mint and redeem), cancel operations where it actually has guardian or canceller authority, and slash the Security Module. The Security Module is a strategy-level, optional first-loss mechanism whose slashing is authorized but discretionary; any module-first absorption is bounded by current stake and slash parameters, and the reviewed terms and team answer do not establish Operator recourse, treasury recapitalization, an external guarantor, binding replenishment, or an enforceable holder loss waterfall.
